# Identity Networking

Takes care of all the messy P2P networking stuff for the identity module.

## What it does

- Hooks into `Hyperswarm` to find other peers.
- Upgrades browser peers to WebRTC so they can talk directly.
- Uses a WebSocket relay for browsers to talk to the main DHT.
- Handles Protomux channels for secure multiplexing.
- If the relay dies, it doesn't crash everything—it just falls back to a chill offline mode.

## Usage

This module is primarily used internally by the `identity` module to bootstrap swarm connections.

```javascript
const identity_networking = require('identity-networking')

// The vault swarm between your own devices, joined with the devices keypair (from crypto-helpers),
// replicates the whole store on every connection
const { swarm } = await identity_networking.network(store, mnemonic_data, relay_url)

// The swarm an app gets (vault.network()), no fixed keypair, never replicates vault cores
const { swarm: app_swarm, replicate } = await identity_networking.create_app_network(store, relay_url)
```

`swarm` is `null` when the browser cant reach the relay. The relay is `relay_url` if given (the vault passes `config/default_relay`), else `ws://localhost:8080` on localhost / LAN addresses, else the hosted relay. That hosted url has no `wss://` and the hosted relay is down right now. The cli doesnt use a relay.
